name: fake_your_own_death_opponents_creature_returns_to_its_owner
notes: Printed: '... gains "When this creature dies, return it to the battlefield tapped under its owner's control and YOU create a Treasure token."' 'You' is the granted trigger's controller: the creature's controller as it died (CR 603.3a), not the player who cast Fake Your Own Death. Seat 0 casts it on seat 1's 2/2; 2 damage kills it. It returns tapped under seat 1's control and seat 1 creates the Treasure: seat 1 then casts Giant Growth on it with no other mana, paid by sacrificing that Treasure.
